note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received by Alexander Millar, secretary, at the County Courthouse, Belfast, on 4 May 1927, withdrawals to 11 May. Withdrawals in Aghalee, Ballycastle and Larne left one contest, in Islandmagee, polled Thursday 2 June 1927 and declared the next day; no nomination was lodged for Carrickfergus, where the retiring member, Alexander Miscampbell, chairman of the council, was deemed re-elected (Northern Whig, 5 May and 4 June; Belfast News-Letter, 12 May and 4 June 1927). No party labels are printed, so none are given. The News-Letter gives 2,449 votes cast, nine of them spoiled, one more than the two candidates' printed totals account for. Smith was the sitting member.
